title: Polynomial threshold representation of four-bit equality
statement: For an input $x\in\{-1,1\}^4$, let $f(x)=-1$ when all four coordinates are equal and $f(x)=1$ otherwise. Let $p(x)=-3+\sum_{0\le i<j<4}x_i x_j$. Then $f(x)=-1$ when $p(x)<0$ and $f(x)=1$ when $p(x)\ge 0$ for every $x\in\{-1,1\}^4$.
hypotheses_covered: Inputs lie in the four-dimensional Boolean cube
The equality function is defined by whether all four coordinates agree
The polynomial is the stated constant plus the sum of all six pairwise products
